content: ADR to actually use the Hermes Kanban board as a live worker queue. Linear stays the source-of-truth for shipped work; Kanban becomes the durable claim/run/heartbeat layer that lets autonomous agents pick up ready tasks without Greg-in-the-loop dispatch.

proof.sourceQuote: Hermes Kanban as autonomous worker queue — adopt dispatcher, end Linear-only operation
